messages:
deploy-bot: deploybot: kickstarting staged rollout for inference-api -> v2026-03-batch-opt at 5% (canary). change-window 23:00-02:00 UTC. release notes: https://redwood/release/2026-03-batch-opt :eyes:
maria: Infra looks good, autoscale pools warmed. watching tail latencies now.
aj: checking perf dashboards — no 5xx, p50/p95 stable. sending heatmap to the channel.
sre-liz: can we pin eu-west-1 to 0% until we confirm no tokenizer drift? prefer keep EU on v2026-03-legacy for now.
deploy-bot: action: region-pin eu-west-1 -> v2026-03-legacy (pinned by @sre-liz).
qa-jun: quick smoke on sample prompts passed. noticed minor formatting quirk in JSON outputs for specialized prompts — filing small regression bug https://redwood/issue/PR-4321
product-eloise: is that regressive enough to block lift to 25%? need runbook impact.
aj: it's cosmetic (trailing commas for some toolchains). not user-facing for majority. i'd say continue to 10% then reevaluate.
maria: @deploy-bot advance to 10%?
deploy-bot: deploybot: advancing rollout to 10% now. traffic shift command:
```
rb traffic shift inference-api v2026-03-batch-opt --to 10
```
ops-bot: note: local change-window maintenance starts 01:15 UTC, will throttle non-critical infra. keep eyes on autoscaler.
sre-liz: ack. set alert: p99 >= 600ms or error-rate > 0.5% will trigger auto-hold.
aj: added alerts: Canaries.Latency.p99 and Canaries.ErrorRate.
product-eloise: stop/go vote: +1 continue to 25% (aj), +1 continue to 25% (maria), -1 hold (sre-liz).
deploy-bot: rollout on hold due to vote: required quorum missing. current traffic: 10%. to proceed, need majority.
maria: i can +1 if we keep EU pinned for now; agree with aj that the issue is cosmetic.
sre-liz: i'll re-check eu tokenizer logs; if clean by 00:45 UTC i'll lift my hold.
qa-jun: running focused locale evals now; will post signal by 00:30 UTC.
deploy-bot: status update: last 15m window — no new 5xx, p99 420ms -> 440ms, error-rate 0.08%.
product-eloise: thanks all. holding until QA signal.
